archetypes.name: progress-windowing
archetypes.rationale: The core risk is off-by-one fallback windowing across review rounds.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the in-flight progress Gantt window selection for both implement and design paths. Focus on round-start-s precedence, N-1-only fallback behavior, malformed ledger rows, and whether round 1 fallback behavior stayed unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: round-start-safety
archetypes.rationale: The change writes round-start-s earlier and must not follow symlinked tmpdir paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the round-start persistence helpers in Python and Bash. Check write-once behavior, symlink guards on round directories and files, and whether failure modes skip safely without breaking normal rounds. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-deadlock
archetypes.rationale: The new mid-round harnesses block worker paths and could hang if release handling regresses.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the threaded Step 5 test and sourced Step 3 loop harness. Focus on timeout, release, and cleanup behavior, plus whether static assertions duplicate live-script literals accurately enough to avoid fragile drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
